svg.title: Financial Report Analyzer — AWS Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end pipeline: PDF ingestion via Web API, Textract parsing, OpenSearch keyword retrieval (3000→100), SageMaker text classification (100→Top3), report assembly into structured JSON and markdown output.

g.text: Web API — annual / quarterly report upload
User uploads PDF via browser · API Gateway validates · stores to S3 raw bucket
Each sentence tagged with page number · stored to S3 Parquet + indexed to OpenSearch
Merges computed values + Top-3 evidence sentences → structured report
